grammar.label: perfect and passive participle clauses
grammar.form: Having + past participle; Having been + past participle; Being + past participle
grammar.meaning: an earlier or background cause, compressed into a phrase

explanation.en: 'Having finished the report, she went home' says the finishing came first. 'Having been warned twice, he stopped' adds a passive. The subject of the participle must be the subject of the main clause, or the sentence dangles.
explanation.uz: 'Having finished the report, she went home' — avval tugatgan, keyin ketgan. Sifatdoshning egasi bosh gapning egasi bilan bir xil bo'lishi shart, aks holda gap mantiqan buziladi.

grammar.positive_example: Having been told twice, he finally changed the figures.
grammar.negative_example: Having been told twice, the figures were finally changed.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilidagi '-gach, -ib' ravishdoshlariga yaqin, lekin ingliz tilida ega mosligi qat'iy talab qilinadi.

grammar.label: absolute constructions — The meeting over, we left
grammar.form: noun phrase + participle or adjective, set off by a comma
grammar.meaning: an accompanying circumstance with its own subject

explanation.en: An absolute clause carries its own subject, so it does not dangle: 'The meeting over, we went back to work', 'Weather permitting, the match will go ahead', 'His hands shaking, he opened the letter'. It is compact and distinctly written English.
explanation.uz: Mustaqil qurilmaning o'z egasi bor, shuning uchun bosh gap egasiga bog'lanmaydi: 'Weather permitting, the match will go ahead'. Bu ixcham va sof yozma uslub belgisi.

grammar.positive_example: Weather permitting, the ceremony will be held outdoors.
grammar.negative_example: Permitting the weather, the ceremony will be held outdoors.

l1_notes.uz: Bu qurilma faqat yozma uslubda uchraydi; og'zaki nutqda 'when the meeting was over' deyish tabiiyroq.

body.text: Having read the file twice, I still cannot find the date of the first warning.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: There is no date. Only 'some time that year'.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Then the chronology is broken, and everything after it is a guess.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I can put it in a participle clause: 'Having been warned twice, the manager did nothing.'

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Only if the manager was the one warned. Otherwise the sentence says the wrong thing.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: He was. It is in the second letter.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Then it works. Watch the subject every time you use that form.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: What about 'The meeting over, the file was closed'?

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: That one is safe. It carries its own subject, so it cannot attach to the wrong person.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: It is very written. That is what a report is. Weather permitting, we finish this today.
